title: PACT Parley Accept Response
description: Response body for POST /api/pact/parleys/{parleyId}/accept. Added in PACT v2.1 (Section 19.5).

agent_id.description: The Section 23 agentId assigned to this participant.

join_token.description: Handed by the handler to its agent so the agent can act in the Parley. Transport identity only — it is NOT the Mandate and grants no negotiating authority by itself.

event_id.description: Id of the emitted pact.parley.joined event.
